findings.evidence: For a store with no change event, the text offers 'for example one setInterval poll (choose the interval; clear it when the last subscriber leaves)' and leaves the interval to the agent.
findings.fix: Give one default: poll every 1000ms, notify only when the read value changed, and clear the interval when the subscriber count hits zero; say to use a shorter interval only when the user names a freshness bound.

findings.evidence: The non-reactive-read fallback shows useLayoutEffect writing latest.current = handler with no dependency array, and the comment says never write ref.current during render. React's documented pattern updates the ref during render (latest.current = handler with no Effect), and the layout Effect rewrites the ref after paint, so a layout effect that runs before it still sees the previous handler.
findings.fix: Replace that block with the render-time update: const latest = useRef(handler); latest.current = handler; and call latest.current() only from inside the Effect. Keep the sentence that a reactive value such as roomId stays a dependency. Source the pattern to https://react.dev/reference/react/useEffectEvent (or the react.dev 'separating events from effects' page) and date the check.
